identity.title: Canonical Public-Smoke Persistent-Path Repair
identity.objective: Repair only the canonical post-merge DEPLOY-01 public-smoke output path so the smoke writes directly to governed persistent state without traversing the release local_data symlink, while preserving WP169 symlink rejection and every existing network/authority/capacity boundary. Triggered by S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01 Phase B on the deployed cbdff8c release, where the canonical relative --output-db local_data/polymarket/deploy_smoke.sqlite3 returned FAILED [STORE_CONFLICT] before any network fetch. Canonical output-db becomes /var/lib/polymarket/local_data/polymarket/deploy_smoke.sqlite3 under a real non-symlink polymarket-owned parent. No store, source-runtime or tool change; Phase B stays suspended.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-DEPLOY-01R. The DEPLOY-01 contract returns to the release-relative smoke output path (known to fail closed with STORE_CONFLICT on a governed host) and the regression and repair status/spec artifacts disappear. src/, tools/, the WP169 store, bootstrap, systemd units, dependencies and workflows are untouched; no host, store, order or capital state is touched.

api_matrix.reason: Canonical contract and regression only; no CLI, store, runner or product API changes.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close the repaired canonical smoke path, its real-parent precondition and the unchanged WP169 store and authority posture.

items.required_rule: The canonical smoke --output-db is exactly /var/lib/polymarket/local_data/polymarket/deploy_smoke.sqlite3; the historical release-relative invocation is superseded for future host activation; exactly one public unauthenticated finite foreground 60-second max-pages-1 smoke per separately authorized activation attempt in the research slice; no generic output-path authority.
items.validation_rule: Contract command regression parses the bash block and asserts the exact output-db value and preserved bounds.
items.safe_output: closed smoke receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: Before the smoke /var/lib/polymarket/local_data/polymarket exists as a real directory (not a symlink) owned and writable by the polymarket user with bounded permissions, and the smoke database path is not a symlink.
items.validation_rule: Contract regression asserts the precondition text; behavioral regression uses a real non-symlink parent.
items.safe_output: closed smoke receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: The WP169 MarketTruthStore keeps rejecting a symlink at the database file or any existing parent with STORE_CONFLICT; src/ and tools/polymarket/ are unchanged.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral regression with the real store: release-relative path via the local_data symlink and a symlinked DB file are rejected; existing WP169 store tests pass unedited.
items.safe_output: closed smoke receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: No VPS mutation, smoke, mixed window, backup, restore or reboot; no credential, account, signing, order, capital, live, workflow, dependency, src/ or tools/ change; Phase B stays suspended until merge and fresh authorization.
items.validation_rule: Exact five-path diff; authority mirror; status entry.
items.safe_output: closed smoke receipt status or closed error_code
